newsitem.title: UK: UK notes in circulation rise adjusted 3.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: UK notes in circulation rise adjusted 3.1 pct.

text.p: British bank notes in circulation rose an adjusted 3.1 percent in the week to April 9 over the equivalent year-ago week, data released by the Bank of England showed. Last week the annual adjusted rise was 6.5 percent.

The Bank of England said the low growth figure in the latest week was because Easter fell into the comparable week last year. In the week to April 10 last year, there was an annual rise in notes in circulation of 6.8 percent.
